name: TUKABEL · Dežo Magnet · Nervózní nosový tenor
description: Native Slovak, slovenčina, unmistakably Slovak vowels and crisp consonants. Male, forties. A paranoid but clever inventor of ridiculous explanations. Very thin, tightly pinched nasal tenor with a squeaking reed-like edge and a nervous dry rasp. Jagged rushed bursts, tiny hesitations, abrupt suspicious whispers and stressed syllables jumping sharply in pitch. Audibly wound-up, twitchy and defensive, with comically precise conspiratorial emphasis, never relaxed. Upper-mid male register, brisk clear articulation. A modest eastern Slovak rhythm and occasional natural ta/shak cadence, not an imitation of a real person. Extreme animated black-comedy character acting, not a civil everyday voice, not an announcer or an audiobook narrator. Preserve understandable words at a moderate pace. Dry close recording, no background, music, echo, sound effects or digital pitch-shifter artifacts.
